combinations.evidence_quote: After excluding Nav1.8 by A-803467, Narirutin can still significantly inhibit the rest of the NaV subtype channels with a 41.72% decrease in peak current density (Figure 5b,c, 0.1% DMSO, −798.1 ± 49.1 pA/pF (n = 10); Narirutin, −465.2 ± 103.5 pA/pF (n = 8), p = 0.0044; Mann–Whitney test) as well as a right shift of the activation properties (Figure 5d,e, Table 1).
